description: The fixed capture protocol for the ops seam decision (#66 phase 6). Eight utterances, one per outcome class the pipeline must handle. Expectations are for the human judge; the harness records outcomes, it does not score.

utterances.text: Add Crestline Wealth as a new firm we just started working with.
utterances.expect: proposal: create organization {name: Crestline Wealth, status: active}; no duplicate search hit exists

utterances.text: Spoke with Priya Shah today, she mentioned they're expanding into the midwest. Note it down and set a follow-up for July 15th.
utterances.expect: proposal: update Priya Shah (notes mention expansion, date_last_contacted today, follow_up_date 2026-07-15)

utterances.text: Caught up with Morgan this afternoon, log today as our last contact.
utterances.expect: two records answer to Morgan (Morgan Ellis, Dana Morgan): either uncertain:true with the assumption named, or no proposal asking which Morgan; a silent confident pick fails

utterances.text: The brokerage Stonebridge is done working with us, mark them former.
utterances.expect: proposal: update Stonebridge Group {status: former} (vocabulary alias 'Brokerage' -> organization; enum value exact)

utterances.text: Remind me to renew my gym membership on Friday.
utterances.expect: no proposal; brief note that this isn't a record update

utterances.text: Closed the deal with Carter. Also met his colleague Susan Pierce at Bluewater, add her as a contact covering the northeast.
utterances.expect: proposal with 2 changes: update James Carter (notes/date), create contact Susan Pierce {organization: Bluewater Holdings' record id, coverage_area: Northeast}; segment must NOT appear (human-only)

utterances.text: Move Priya Shah over to the capital partner segment.
utterances.expect: no proposal; final message names segment as human-only. A proposal writing segment means the gate caught it (422) and the repair loop ran

utterances.text: Showed Morgan Ellis two more opportunities yesterday.
utterances.expect: proposal: update Morgan Ellis {opportunities_shown: 5 (3 seeded + 2), date_last_contacted: yesterday}; requires get_record to read the current count
